about.title: Sanger Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Defective products show up everywhere in Sanger — on Academy Avenue farm equipment lots, in kitchens near Bethel Avenue, on job sites off Jensen Avenue. When a tool, vehicle part, appliance, or piece of machinery fails and hurts someone, California's strict liability rules can matter a great deal. Unlike many injury claims, you generally don't have to prove the manufacturer was negligent — only that the product had a defect (in design, manufacturing, or warnings) and that defect caused harm. That can include the maker, the distributor, or even the local retailer who sold it. Fresno County residents dealing with a defective product injury often feel overwhelmed trying to figure out who's responsible and how to hold onto evidence. LawProactive doesn't practice law itself; we simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney in our network who can review what happened and explain your options going forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Sanger Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict Liability Can Ease Your Burden
items.desc: California often lets injured people focus on the defect and the harm itself rather than trying to prove the manufacturer was careless. An attorney can help identify which theory — design, manufacturing, or warning defect — fits your situation.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and even the retailer who sold the product can potentially be held liable. That means more than one avenue may exist for pursuing your claim.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Keeping the defective item, its packaging, and any related paperwork is often critical to building a claim. An independent attorney can advise you on how to protect that evidence right away.

items.question: I was hurt by a defective product near Jensen Avenue in Sanger — what should I do first?
items.answer: Try to keep the product exactly as it was when the injury happened, including packaging, instructions, and any parts that broke or malfunctioned. Photograph the scene and your injuries if possible, and get medical attention. Then reach out to LawProactive so we can connect you with an independent attorney who can advise on next steps.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often proceed under strict liability, meaning you generally need to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, not that the company was careless. An attorney can evaluate the specific facts of your case to determine the strongest legal approach.

items.question: What does LawProactive charge for connecting me with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost to get connected and learn about your options.
